title: Atomized Usage Ledger UI prototype for pricing transparency
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, exportable 'Atomized Usage Ledger' view for the Redwood Console that surfaces per-unit economics at the smallest billable granularity (message/token/embedding unit) and integrates pricing slab patterns for quick what-if comparisons. This ticket covers exploratory prototypes, accessibility review, engineering handoff artifacts, and a lightweight interaction spec for rollouts and permissioned exports.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity prototype in Figma: ledger rows that expand to show per-call breakdown (model, tokens in/out, KV cache hits, quantization overrides)
Export preserves attribution columns: route_id, model_version, user_id (anon), tokens_in, tokens_out, unit_cost, line_total, pricing_slab_id
Pricing pattern micro-interactions: inline slab preview and a compare-mode toggler to preview alternate pricing tiers
Design tokens, spacing, and colors match Console design system and pass accessibility AA for contrast
Interaction spec for engineering including keyboard flows, row virtualization behavior for large result sets, and RBAC gating for exports
notes: Primary goal: make hidden per-unit costs discoverable without overwhelming engineers with raw token tables
Secondary goal: enable quick export for finance and SRE teams to run offline reconcilations
We intentionally avoid shipping heavy analytics queries in the client — prototype assumes a paginated endpoint that returns pre-aggregated atomic line items
Privacy: exports must allow an anonymized mode (user_id hashed) — engineering to confirm hashing approach with Security team
comments: 2026-03-05 Maya Chen: Initial exploratory wireframes uploaded. Two main paths: (A) dense ledger + inline expand; (B) card-based per-route breakdown. Favoring (A) for scanability. Added initial export CSV schema.

2026-03-06 Arjun Patel (PM): Reviewed. Need to show how pricing slabs apply to each line item and an affordance to 'simulate alternate tier' without changing customer config. Also request: include a column for 'cache_impact' (KV hits avoided).

2026-03-08 Samira Gomez (Eng): Backend reachable output shape OK. Confirmed the endpoint will include per-line pricing_slab_id and hashed_user_id. Raised concern about pagination + sorting for large workspaces; recommended server-side cursoring and sample query plan (GH #4128).

2026-03-09 Leo Martin (Research): Quick 5-user read test: participants preferred inline expand with micro-summaries. Confusion on the term 'unit' — recommend labeling as 'billable unit' and a hover tooltip explaining token vs message vs embedding unit per model.

2026-03-10 Accessibility review (Ava Singh): Contrast pass for primary text; expanded row header needs aria-expanded and proper table semantics. Flagged keyboard trap on the compare-mode panel — design updated to ensure focus returns to toggler.

2026-03-11 Arjun Patel (PM): Asked design to add a compact 'reconciliation export' preset that drops PII and includes cost attribution columns only. Also requested a small onboarding tooltip for first-time users of the ledger.

2026-03-12 Maya Chen (Design): Uploaded final prototype and interaction spec. Added export presets: Full Detail, Finance-Only (anonymized), SRE-Usage (includes latency/cold-start flags). Ready for engineering handoff; scheduling walkthrough on 2026-03-14.
